concerns.text: The core analysis (partial correlations, ridge regression, etc.) depends on a paired resting‑state fMRI + MER dataset that does not exist in any verified open source. The plan’s validation gate halts execution, meaning the research question cannot be answered under the current methodology.

The MER construct is taken as a single ‘mer_score’ without any verification that the source dataset provides a validated musical‑emotion rating instrument. Construct validity of the behavioral measure is therefore unclear.

Power analysis flags under‑powered status (N < 194) but the pipeline still proceeds to run the primary statistical tests. Conducting inferential analyses on an under‑powered sample risks false‑negative or unstable results; the plan should either abort or treat results as strictly exploratory with appropriate caveats.
